design.decision: Underbid weak hands, or pair a nil with a small bid, and then play to make it.
design.opponent: Revealed at bidding; opponents get room to bid high and should try to set the small contract.
design.rationale: Runs against bid tension on purpose: it is the Nil team's natural contract shape, and the skill-and-bidding metrics should show whether it drains tension.
design.draftText: +10 contract multiplier when your team bids 4 or less

critic.concerns: Works against bid tension on purpose and may reward sandbagging; watch the bidding metrics.

history.note: draft-common: the enumerator also produced this signature (e-bid4less-mult); credited to both sources.
